analytics_event_asset_id_required.name: analytics_event_asset_id_required
analytics_event_asset_id_required.value: CASE WHEN asset_type = 'chat' THEN chat_id IS NOT NULL WHEN asset_type = 'story' THEN story_id IS NOT NULL ELSE TRUE END

favorite_xor_target.name: favorite_xor_target
favorite_xor_target.value: ("favorite"."story_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("favorite"."folder_id" IS NOT NULL) = 1

text_required_if_type_is_text.name: text_required_if_type_is_text
text_required_if_type_is_text.value: CASE WHEN type = 'text' THEN text IS NOT NULL ELSE TRUE END

reasoning_text_required_if_type_is_reaso.name: reasoning_text_required_if_type_is_reasoning
reasoning_text_required_if_type_is_reaso.value: CASE WHEN type = 'reasoning' THEN reasoning_text IS NOT NULL ELSE TRUE END

tool_call_fields_required.name: tool_call_fields_required
tool_call_fields_required.value: CASE WHEN type LIKE 'tool-%' THEN tool_call_id IS NOT NULL AND tool_state IS NOT NULL ELSE TRUE END

file_fields_required.name: file_fields_required
file_fields_required.value: CASE WHEN type = 'file' THEN media_type IS NOT NULL ELSE TRUE END

local_project_path_required.name: local_project_path_required
local_project_path_required.value: CASE WHEN "type" = 'local' THEN "path" IS NOT NULL ELSE TRUE END

story_owner_required.name: story_owner_required
story_owner_required.value: chat_id IS NOT NULL OR (project_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL)
